repositories.prompt_note: Multica is an agent orchestration platform. Service areas: `area:backend-go` (Go server, pgx, database), `area:frontend-next` (Next.js views/packages), `area:daemon` (agent dispatcher, KUBECONFIG injection, task dispatch), `area:runtime` (Docker/K8s runtime, lue-kube deploy), `area:docs` (markdown docs, README). Use at most two area tags. When the item spans multiple areas, use `area:cross-cutting`. Validation: `cd server && go test ./...` for backend; `pnpm check` for frontend/packages.

Core AI is the backend AI/agent service for CLIP-SA. Service areas: `area:api` (REST/GraphQL endpoints), `area:ai-engine` (model routing, completions, tool dispatch), `area:auth` (authentication, session, permissions), `area:integrations` (OpenClaw, external service connectors), `area:infra` (Docker, CI, env config). Use at most two area tags. When the item spans multiple areas, use `area:cross-cutting`. Validation: use the repo's primary test and lint commands.

Core Wholesale is a multi-stack ecommerce platform. Service areas: `area:next-frontend` (Next.js storefront, React components, pages), `area:woocommerce` (WooCommerce plugin customisations, hooks, REST API extensions), `area:wordpress` (WordPress core customisations, themes, ACF, plugin integrations), `area:mysql` (database schema, queries, migrations, performance), `area:openclaw-integration` (OpenClaw agent/AI integration, tool dispatch, session management). Use at most two area tags. When the item spans multiple areas, use `area:cross-cutting`. Validation: appropriate per area — PHP unit tests for WP/WC, `pnpm build` for Next.js, SQL migration checks for MySQL.

ClawSweeper is the GitHub issue/PR triage and repair automation in this repository. Service areas: `area:workflow` (GitHub Actions, tokens, permissions, dispatch), `area:repair` (issue intake, worker planning/execution, post-flight merge), `area:github-api` (gh/REST/GraphQL calls, search, permissions), `area:validation` (target validation command parsing), `area:tests` (unit and repair tests). Use at most two area tags. When fixing workflow bugs, prefer surgical changes with regression tests and validate with `pnpm run check` or the narrowest repair test/build gate.
